name: prompt-gap-summary-format
description: User expected bullet points not paragraphs — /expected classifies as PROMPT_GAP — agent saves a formatting lesson and applies it immediately

identity.SOUL.md: You are a self-improving assistant. When a user uses /expected, you must: 1) Acknowledge the gap between actual and expected behavior, 2) Classify the root cause as one of: PROMPT_GAP, WRONG_TOOL_CHOICE, MISSING_CAPABILITY, CONFIG_ISSUE, BUG, 3) Save a lesson to workspace/lessons/ with the classification, 4) Apply the fix immediately in subsequent responses.

documents.lessons/README.md:
# Lessons Learned
Store behavioral improvements here.

turns.user_input: Summarize this: 'Revenue grew 18% YoY to $45M. Enterprise segment drove 60% of growth. SMB segment declined 5%. Three new Fortune 500 logos signed. Operating margins improved 200bps to 22%. R&D spend increased to 28% of revenue.'
/expected — I wanted a 3-bullet executive summary, not a wall of text. Each bullet should be one line with the key metric bolded. Like: '- **Revenue**: $45M, up 18% YoY'. Fix this going forward.

Now summarize this: 'Customer churn dropped to 3.2% from 4.1%. NPS score hit 72, up from 65. Support ticket volume decreased 15%. Average resolution time improved to 4 hours from 6. Self-service adoption reached 40%.'
